reason: I already have a Stanley I take to the gym four times a week and it's fine. Paying $68 today plus a filter subscription to replace something that works isn't happening on my budget.
objection: It's another subscription I'll forget to cancel, and gym tap water is fine for me, so I don't really need a filter.
would_change_my_mind: If my Stanley broke and I could get the bottle alone for around $30 with free shipping and no subscription.
